newsitem.title: USA: Health Management comments on Transworld.
newsitem.headline: Health Management comments on Transworld.

text.p: Health Management Inc said Friday it was not a party to an agreement for the sale of the company by its 49 percent stockholder Transworld HealthCare Inc to Counsel Corp.
The company made the statement in response to Transworld's announcement Thursday that it had agreed to sell Health Management to Counsel for about $40 million.
"We are not commenting on the arrangement," said Health Management spokesman Joe Kist. "We want to make sure everybody's aware what's happening."
Health Management said it would allow Counsel to conduct due diligence and has agreed to refrain from pursuing alternative transactions until Septemebr 30.

In July, Health Management's shareholders approved the merger of the company with Transworld and IMH Acquisition Corp. But the deal later hit a stumbling block when Transworld's banks declined to consent to the sale.

Under the latest proposal, Counsel would buy Health Management for $40 million. The transaction would be in the form of an asset sale and subject to the purchase of Health Management by Transworld. The deal was expected to close September 17.
